summary: This is a Gherkin feature file that describes a test scenario for a website's blog functionality. It verifies that clicking the Blog menu item from the homepage navigates the user to the blog page.

explanations.1: The Feature line describes the overall user-facing behavior being tested — in this case, that the Blog menu works as expected.
explanations.3: Scenario is a keyword that introduces a specific test case or example of the feature in action.
explanations.4: Given sets up the initial state before the test runs — the user starts on the homepage.
explanations.5: Then is an action step that simulates what the user does — clicking the Blog menu.
explanations.6: Then is used again to assert what should happen as a result — the page URL should change to /blog.
